title: Vajradamstra shows terror among the monkeys
introduction: The powerful demon Vajradamshtra penetrated the army of monkeys, sowing terror among them. The monkeys then sought refuge with Angada the monkey-leader. A fierce battle ensues between Vajradamshtra and Angada. Angada assaults Vajradamshtra with a sword and Vajradamshtra's head falls on the ground.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये युद्धकाण्डे चतुःपचाशः सर्गः
Thus completes 54th Chapter of Yuddha Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
स्वबलस्य च घातेन अङ्गदस्य बलेन च |
राषसः क्रोधमाविष्टो वज्रदंष्ट्रो महाबलः
verses.iast:
svabalasya ca ghātena aṇ^gadasya balena ca |
rāṣasaḥ krodhamāviṣṭo vajradaṃṣṭro mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: The devastation of his army through Angada's prowess filled the mighty Vajradamstra with anger.

verses.devanagari:
विस्फार्य च धनुर्घोरं शक्राशनिसमप्रभम् |
वानराणामनीकानि प्राकिरच्छरवृष्टिभिः
verses.iast:
visphārya ca dhanurghoraṃ śakrāśanisamaprabham |
vānarāṇāmanīkāni prākiraccharavṛṣṭibhiḥ
verses.translation: Stretching his terrific bow, like unto Indra's thunder bolt, he assailed the monkey battalions with a flood of arrows.

glosses.meaning: samaprabham = which had a spledour equal to that of the thunderbolt of Indra the Lord of celestials

verses.devanagari:
राक्षसाश्चापि मुख्यास्ते रथैश्च समवस्थिताः |
नानाप्रहरणाः शूराः प्रायुध्यन्त तदा रणे
verses.iast:
rākṣasāścāpi mukhyāste rathaiśca samavasthitāḥ |
nānāpraharaṇāḥ śūrāḥ prāyudhyanta tadā raṇe
verses.translation: Then, the foremost of the demons mounted on chariots, fought the battle with every kind of weapon.

verses.devanagari:
वानराणाम् च शूरास्तु ते सर्वे प्लवगर्षभाः |
आयुध्यन्त शिलाहस्तः समवेताः समन्ततः
verses.iast:
vānarāṇām ca śūrāstu te sarve plavagarṣabhāḥ |
āyudhyanta śilāhastaḥ samavetāḥ samantataḥ
verses.translation: The monkeys, those valiant bulls among the Plavagas, assembling on all sides, fought with rocks.

verses.devanagari:
तत्रायुधसहस्राणि तस्मिन्नायोधने भृशम् |
राक्षसाः कपिमुख्येषु पातयांचक्रिरे तदा
verses.iast:
tatrāyudhasahasrāṇi tasminnāyodhane bhṛśam |
rākṣasāḥ kapimukhyeṣu pātayāñcakrire tadā
verses.translation: Then in that battle there, the demons abundantly hurled thousands of weapons on the foremost of monkeys.

verses.devanagari:
वानराश्चैव रक्षसु गिरिवृक्षान् महाशिलाः |
प्रवीराः पातयामासुर्मत्तवारणसम्निभाः
verses.iast:
vānarāścaiva rakṣasu girivṛkṣān mahāśilāḥ |
pravīrāḥ pātayāmāsurmattavāraṇasamnibhāḥ
verses.translation: The monkeys of mighty prowess, resembling elephants in rut, showered down giant trees and huge lumps of rock on the demons.

verses.devanagari:
शूराणाम् युध्यमानानाम् समरेष्वनिवर्त्नाम् |
तद्रक्षसगणानाम् च स्युद्धं समवर्तत
verses.iast:
śūrāṇām yudhyamānānām samareṣvanivartnām |
tadrakṣasagaṇānām ca syuddhaṃ samavartata
verses.translation: Between those courageous warriors, the demons and the monkeys, who never retreated in battle, a tremendous struggle ensued.

verses.devanagari:
प्रभग्नशिरसः केचिछिन्नैः पादैश्च बाहुभिः |
सस्त्रैरर्दितदेहास्तु रुधिरेण समुक्षिताः
हरयो राक्षसाश्चैन शेरते गाम् समाश्रिताः |
कङ्कगृध्राबलाढ्यश्च गोमायुकुलसंकुलाः
verses.iast:
prabhagnaśirasaḥ kecichinnaiḥ pādaiśca bāhubhiḥ |
sastrairarditadehāstu rudhireṇa samukṣitāḥ
harayo rākṣasāścaina śerate gām samāśritāḥ |
kaṇ^kagṛdhrābalāḍhyaśca gomāyukulasaṅkulāḥ
verses.translation: Some monkeys and demons, with their shattered heads, but bereft of arms and legs, lay on the earth bathed in blood with their bodies wounded by weapons, a prey to herons vultures and crows or devoured by troops of jackals.

glosses.meaning: cut feet baahubhiH = and hands ardita dehaaH = bodies wounded
surrounded by groups of herons vultures and crows
as also surrounded by groups of jackals

verses.devanagari:
कबन्धानि समुत्पेतुर्भीमाणाम् भीषणानि वै |
भुजपाणिशिरश्छिन्नाश्छिन्नकायाश्च भूतले
वानरा राक्षसाश्चापि निपेतुस्तत्र भूतले |
verses.iast:
kabandhāni samutpeturbhīmāṇām bhīṣaṇāni vai |
bhujapāṇiśiraśchinnāśchinnakāyāśca bhūtale
vānarā rākṣasāścāpi nipetustatra bhūtale |
verses.translation: Monkeys and demons fell on the battle-field; headless trunks leaps up to the terror of all the fearful, their limbs hacked to pieces in the combat.

glosses.meaning: on the surface of the earth
and their limbs hacked to pieces.

verses.devanagari:
ततो वानरसैन्येन हन्यमानम् निशाचरम्
प्राभज्यत बलं सर्वं वज्रदंष्ट्रस्य पश्यत |
verses.iast:
tato vānarasainyena hanyamānam niśācaram
prābhajyata balaṃ sarvaṃ vajradaṃṣṭrasya paśyata |
verses.translation: Thereafter, under the eyes of Vajradamshtra, all his army of demons were killed and broken up by the monkey-troops.

verses.devanagari:
राक्षसान् भयवित्रस्तान् हन्यमानान् प्लवङ्गमैः
दृष्ट्वा स रोषताम्राक्षो वज्रदंष्ट्रः प्रतापवान् |
प्रविवेश धनुष्पाणि स्त्रासयन् हरिवाहिनीम्
verses.iast:
rākṣasān bhayavitrastān hanyamānān plavaṇ^gamaiḥ
dṛṣṭvā sa roṣatāmrākṣo vajradaṃṣṭraḥ pratāpavān |
praviveśa dhanuṣpāṇi strāsayan harivāhinīm
verses.translation: Seeing the demons terrified with fear and decimated by the monkeys, that powerful Vajradamshtra, his eyes red with anger, bow in hand, penetrated the army of monkeys, sowing panic among them.

glosses.meaning: his eyes becoming red with anger
and wielding a bow in his hands

verses.devanagari:
शरैर्विदारयामास कङ्कपत्रैरजिह्मगैः |
बिभेद वानरांस्तत्र सप्तष्टौ नव पञ्च च
विव्याध परमक्रुद्धो वज्रदंष्ट्रः प्रतापवान् |
verses.iast:
śarairvidārayāmāsa kaṇ^kapatrairajihmagaiḥ |
bibheda vānarāṃstatra saptaṣṭau nava paJṇca ca
vivyādha paramakruddho vajradaṃṣṭraḥ pratāpavān |
verses.translation: Thereafter, in his fury, the vigorous Vajradamshtra dispatched those monkeys with arrows resembling wings of an eagle that flew straight to their target and pierced seven, eight, nine or five of his opponents simultaneously, thus destroying them.

verses.devanagari:
त्रस्ताः सर्वे हरिगणाः शरैः संकृत्तदेहिनः
अङ्गदं सम्प्रधावन्ति प्रजापतिमिव प्रजाः |
verses.iast:
trastāḥ sarve harigaṇāḥ śaraiḥ saṅkṛttadehinaḥ
aṇ^gadaṃ sampradhāvanti prajāpatimiva prajāḥ |
verses.translation: With their limbs crippled by those arrows and frightened, those monkey battalions sought refuge with Angada, as all creatures with Brahma the Lord of Creation.

glosses.meaning: towards Brahma the Lord of creation.

verses.devanagari:
ततो हरिगणान् भग्नान् दृष्ट्वा वालिसुतस्तदा
क्रोधेन वज्रदंष्ट्रम् त मुदीक्षन्तमुदैक्षत |
verses.iast:
tato harigaṇān bhagnān dṛṣṭvā vālisutastadā
krodhena vajradaṃṣṭram ta mudīkṣantamudaikṣata |
verses.translation: When he beheld those monkey troops fleeing in disorder, Angada the son Vali exchanged glances of hatred with Vajradamshtra.

verses.devanagari:
वज्रदम्ष्ट्रोऽङ्गदस्चोभौ योयुध्येते परस्परम्
चेरतुः परमक्रुद्धौ हरिमत्तगजाविव |
verses.iast:
vajradamṣṭro'ṇ^gadascobhau yoyudhyete parasparam
ceratuḥ paramakruddhau harimattagajāviva |
verses.translation: Both Vajradamshtra and Angada fought against each other like a lion and an elephant in rut. They strolled din a tremendous fury.

glosses.meaning: like a lion and an elephant in rut

verses.devanagari:
ततः शतसहस्रेण हरिपुत्रं महाबलम्
जघान मर्मदेशेषु शरैरग्निशिखोपमैः |
verses.iast:
tataḥ śatasahasreṇa hariputraṃ mahābalam
jaghāna marmadeśeṣu śarairagniśikhopamaiḥ |
verses.translation: Thereafter, that Vajradamshtra knocked the mighty Angada at his vital organs with his arrows resembling hundred thousand flames of fire.

glosses.meaning: resembling a hundred thousand flames of fire.

verses.devanagari:
रुधिरोक्षितसर्वाङ्गो वालिसूनुर्महाबलः
चिक्षेप वज्रदंष्ट्रय वृक्षं भीमपराक्रमः |
verses.iast:
rudhirokṣitasarvāṇ^go vālisūnurmahābalaḥ
cikṣepa vajradaṃṣṭraya vṛkṣaṃ bhīmaparākramaḥ |
verses.translation: With all his limbs drenched in blood, the mighty Angada having a terrific prowess threw a tree on Vajradamshtra.

glosses.meaning: with all his limbs drenched in blood

verses.devanagari:
दृष्ट्वापतन्तं तम् वृक्षमसंभ्रान्तश्च राक्षसः
चिछेद बहुधा सोऽपि मथितः प्रापतद्भुवि |
verses.iast:
dṛṣṭvāpatantaṃ tam vṛkṣamasambhrāntaśca rākṣasaḥ
cicheda bahudhā so'pi mathitaḥ prāpatadbhuvi |
verses.translation: That unperplexed demon, seeing that tree falling on him, cut it into innumerable pieces which fell in heaps on earth.

verses.devanagari:
तं दृष्ट्वा स रथादाप्लुत्य वीर्यवान्
गदापाणिरसंभ्रान्तः पृथिव्यां समतिष्ठत |
verses.iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā sa rathādāplutya vīryavān
gadāpāṇirasambhrāntaḥ pṛthivyāṃ samatiṣṭhata |
verses.translation: Witnessing the strength of Vajradamshtra, Angada that lion among the monkeys seized hold of a large rock and emitting a shout, threw it on him.

glosses.meaning: Angada that lion among the monkeys

verses.devanagari:
तमापतन्तं दृष्ट्वा स रथादाप्लुत्य वीर्यवान्
गदापाणिरसंभ्रान्तः पृथिव्यां समतिष्ठत |
verses.iast:
tamāpatantaṃ dṛṣṭvā sa rathādāplutya vīryavān
gadāpāṇirasambhrāntaḥ pṛthivyāṃ samatiṣṭhata |
verses.translation: As the rock descended, that vigorous Vajradamshtra leaping down from his chariot, armed with his mace, stood waiting unperplexed, on the battle-field.

verses.devanagari:
अङ्गदेन शिला क्षिप्ता गत्वा तु रणमूर्धनि
सचक्रकूबरं साश्वं प्रममाथ रथं तदा |
verses.iast:
aṇ^gadena śilā kṣiptā gatvā tu raṇamūrdhani
sacakrakūbaraṃ sāśvaṃ pramamātha rathaṃ tadā |
verses.translation: Meanwhile, the rock thrown by Angada, falling into the forefront of the battle, then crushed the chariot with its wheels shafts and horses

glosses.meaning: into the forefront of the battle

verses.devanagari:
ततोऽन्यच्छिखरं गृह्य विपुलं द्रुमभूषितम्
वज्रदंष्ट्रस्य शिरसि पातयामास वानरः |
verses.iast:
tato'nyacchikharaṃ gṛhya vipulaṃ drumabhūṣitam
vajradaṃṣṭrasya śirasi pātayāmāsa vānaraḥ |
verses.translation: Thereafter, Angada the monkey, seizing another large peak of a mountain adorned with trees, threw it on Vajradamshtra's head.

verses.devanagari:
अभवच्छोणितोद्गारी वज्रदंष्ट्रः स मूर्छितः
मूहूर्तमभवन्मूढो गदामालिङ्ग्य निःश्वसन् |
verses.iast:
abhavacchoṇitodgārī vajradaṃṣṭraḥ sa mūrchitaḥ
mūhūrtamabhavanmūḍho gadāmāliṇ^gya niḥśvasan |
verses.translation: Beginning to vomit blood, Vajradamshtra became fainted, clenching his mace convulsively and breathing heavily for a moment.

verses.devanagari:
संलब्धसंज्ञो गदया वालिपुत्रमवस्थितम्
जघान परमक्रुद्धो वक्षोदेशे निशाचरः |
verses.iast:
saṃlabdhasañjJṇo gadayā vāliputramavasthitam
jaghāna paramakruddho vakṣodeśe niśācaraḥ |
verses.translation: Regaining his consciousness, Vajradamshtra the demon was very much enraged and hit Angada full on the chest with his mace.

verses.devanagari:
गदां त्यक्त्वा ततस्तत्र मुष्टियुद्धमकुर्वत
अन्योन्यं जघ्नतुस्तत्र तावुभौ हरिराक्षसौ |
verses.iast:
gadāṃ tyaktvā tatastatra muṣṭiyuddhamakurvata
anyonyaṃ jaghnatustatra tāvubhau harirākṣasau |
verses.translation: Leaving his mace, he performed a pugilistic encounter there. Both the monkey and the demon thus hit each other in that combat.

verses.devanagari:
रुधिरोद्गारिणौ तौ तु प्रहारैर्जनितशमौ
बभूवतुः सुविक्रन्तावङ्गारक बुधाविव |
verses.iast:
rudhirodgāriṇau tau tu prahārairjanitaśamau
babhūvatuḥ suvikrantāvaṇ^gāraka budhāviva |
verses.translation: Exhausted by the blows, spitting blood, those valiant warriors were like the planets Mars and Mercury.

glosses.meaning: like the planets Mars and Mercury.

verses.devanagari:
ततः परमतेजस्वी अङ्गदः प्लवगर्षभः
उत्पाट्य वृक्षं स्थितवान् बहुपुष्प फलाचितम् |
verses.iast:
tataḥ paramatejasvī aṇ^gadaḥ plavagarṣabhaḥ
utpāṭya vṛkṣaṃ sthitavān bahupuṣpa phalācitam |
verses.translation: Then, Angada the lion among the monkeys, possessing a great splendour, uprooted a tree full with many flowers and fruits and stood waiting.

glosses.meaning: full with many flowers and fruits

verses.devanagari:
जग्राह चार्षभं चर्म खड्गं च विपुलं शुभम्
किङ्किणाजालसंभन्नम् चर्मणा च परिष्कृतम् |
verses.iast:
jagrāha cārṣabhaṃ carma khaḍgaṃ ca vipulaṃ śubham
kiṇ^kiṇājālasambhannam carmaṇā ca pariṣkṛtam |
verses.translation: The demon too seized hold of a shield covered with the hide of a bull as well as a great beautiful sword decorated richly with a multitude of golden bells.

glosses.meaning: covered with the hide of a bull
richly with a multitude with a multitude of golden bells.

verses.devanagari:
चित्रांश्च रुचिरान्मार्गांश्चेरतुः कपिराक्षसौ
जघ्नतुश्च तदान्योन्यम् नर्दन्तौ जयाकाङिक्षिणौ |
verses.iast:
citrāṃśca rucirānmārgāṃśceratuḥ kapirākṣasau
jaghnatuśca tadānyonyam nardantau jayākāṇ^ikṣiṇau |
verses.translation: Thirsting for victory, the monkeys and the demons, making roaring sounds, roamed about in different ways and collided with each other.

verses.devanagari:
व्रणैः समुथैः शोभेतां पुष्पिताविव किंशुकौ
युध्यमानौ परिश्रानौ जानुभ्यामवनीम् गतौ |
verses.iast:
vraṇaiḥ samuthaiḥ śobhetāṃ puṣpitāviva kiṃśukau
yudhyamānau pariśrānau jānubhyāmavanīm gatau |
verses.translation: With their gaping wounds, they shone like a pair of kimshuka trees in blossom. Exhausted were both of them while fighting and they sank their knees on the earth.

glosses.meaning: like a pair of kimshuka trees

verses.devanagari:
निमेषान्तरमात्रेण अङ्गदह् कपिकुञ्जरः
उदतिष्ठत दीप्ताक्षो दण्डाहत इवोरगः |
verses.iast:
nimeṣāntaramātreṇa aṇ^gadah kapikuJṇjaraḥ
udatiṣṭhata dīptākṣo daṇḍāhata ivoragaḥ |
verses.translation: Angada, the foremost of the monkeys, just after a moment, with his glittering eyes, rose up like a serpent struck with a stick.

verses.devanagari:
निर्मलेन सुधौतेन खड्गेनास्य महच्छिरः
जघान वज्रदंष्ट्रस्य वालिसूनुर्महाबलः |
verses.iast:
nirmalena sudhautena khaḍgenāsya mahacchiraḥ
jaghāna vajradaṃṣṭrasya vālisūnurmahābalaḥ |
verses.translation: The mighty Angada assaulted the giant head of Vajradamshtra with a well-sharpened and stainless sword.

verses.devanagari:
रुधिरोक्षितगात्रस्य बभूव पतितम् द्विधा
तच्च तस्य परीताक्षं शुभम् खड्गहतम् शिरः |
verses.iast:
rudhirokṣitagātrasya babhūva patitam dvidhā
tacca tasya parītākṣaṃ śubham khaḍgahatam śiraḥ |
verses.translation: Struck by the sword, that charming head of Vajradamshtra, with his limbs drenched in blood and eyes rolling, fell into two pieces.

glosses.meaning: with his limbs drenched with blood

verses.devanagari:
वज्रदंष्ट्रम् हतम् दृष्ट्वा राक्षसा भयमोहिताः
त्रस्तह्यभ्यद्रवन् लङ्काम् वध्यमानाः प्लवङ्गमैः |
विषण्ळवदना दीना ह्रिया किंचिदवाङ्मुखाः
verses.iast:
vajradaṃṣṭram hatam dṛṣṭvā rākṣasā bhayamohitāḥ
trastahyabhyadravan laṇ^kām vadhyamānāḥ plavaṇ^gamaiḥ |
viṣaṇLavadanā dīnā hriyā kiṃcidavāṇ^mukhāḥ
verses.translation: Seeing Vajradamshtra having been slain, the demons, deluded with fear, fled panic-stricken towards Lanka, harassed by the monkeys with their down-cast faces, their heads bowed in shame.

glosses.meaning: due to a little of shame

verses.devanagari:
निहत्य तम् वज्रधरप्रतापः |
स वालिसूनुः कपिसैन्यमध्ये |
जगाम हर्षम् महितो महाबलः |
सहस्रनेत्रस्त्रिदशैरिवावृतः
verses.iast:
nihatya tam vajradharapratāpaḥ |
sa vālisūnuḥ kapisainyamadhye |
jagāma harṣam mahito mahābalaḥ |
sahasranetrastridaśairivāvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The mighty Angada experienced a great joy amidst the monkey forces, honoured by them for his high courage and he resembled the Lord of a Thousand Eyes surrounded by the celestials.

glosses.meaning: with a strength of Indra the Lord of celestials
like Lord of a thousand eyes
